name: aws_fsx_windows_file_system
description: Fully managed native Windows file system with SMB protocol support and Active Directory integration

storage_capacity.name: storage_capacity
storage_capacity.description: Storage capacity in GiB (min 32 for SSD, 2000 for HDD)

subnet_ids.name: subnet_ids
subnet_ids.description: Subnet IDs where the file system will be accessible (1 for Single-AZ, 2 for Multi-AZ)

active_directory_id.name: active_directory_id
active_directory_id.description: ID of an AWS Managed Microsoft AD instance (conflicts with self_managed_active_directory)

kms_key_id.name: kms_key_id
kms_key_id.description: ARN of KMS key for encryption at rest (defaults to AWS managed key)

security_group_ids.name: security_group_ids
security_group_ids.description: Security group IDs for the file system network interfaces

preferred_subnet_id.name: preferred_subnet_id
preferred_subnet_id.description: Subnet ID for the preferred file server (Multi-AZ only)

automatic_backup_retention_days.name: automatic_backup_retention_days
automatic_backup_retention_days.description: Days to retain automatic backups (0-90, 0 disables)

copy_tags_to_backups.name: copy_tags_to_backups
copy_tags_to_backups.description: Copy file system tags to backups

daily_automatic_backup_start_time.name: daily_automatic_backup_start_time
daily_automatic_backup_start_time.description: Daily backup start time in HH:MM UTC format

skip_final_backup.name: skip_final_backup
skip_final_backup.description: Skip final backup when the file system is deleted

weekly_maintenance_start_time.name: weekly_maintenance_start_time
weekly_maintenance_start_time.description: Weekly maintenance window (d:HH:MM UTC, d=1-7 Mon-Sun)

aliases.name: aliases
aliases.description: DNS alias names for the file system (e.g., accounting.example.com)

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags to apply to the file system
